caption: The drawing features a single object at its center: a pewter pitcher. The pitcher is rendered in shades of gray, with a metallic sheen suggesting its material. It has a fitted lid with a knob on top, a wide spout extending to the left, and an ornate handle curving to the right with a decorative thumb piece. The lid also has a small ornamental finial. The main body of the pitcher is cylindrical, widening slightly at its base. The handle has a scrolling shape and attaches at the top and bottom of the upper half of the pitcher. The background consists of a soft gradient blending from a light beige at the bottom to a deep brown and then to a desaturated blue or gray toward the top and sides, creating a subtle contrast with the pitcher. Below the pitcher, there is a dark brown rectangular section containing white text that reads: "AMERICAN PEWTER PITCHER Collection of Mr. Baldwin Coolidge." The overall composition is centered, and the pitcher is depicted in profile view, oriented left to right.
title: Pewter Pitcher
